title: An old map of Beijing
blurb: An old map of Beijing at 潘家园 shows the city walls that are gone.
lead: The book-seller at 潘家园 has something old rolled up on his stall.

steps.now: The book-seller at 潘家园 has an old map of Beijing — bargain for it.
steps.past: Bargained for an old map of Beijing at 潘家园.
